summary: Full E2E testing of iteration 3 features: admin auth (login/logout/me/lockout), admin dashboard endpoints (list/patch/stats), spam shield (honeypot + IP rate-limit), and UI flow at /admin plus honeypot behaviour on public appointment dialog. 12/12 pytest backend cases passed. All 17 Playwright UI checks passed (login errors, dashboard render, filter tabs, refresh, book-from-public flow, appointment appears in admin, Confirm/Cancel status updates, sign out returning to login, protected redirect on manual /admin visit, mobile 2-col stats grid with no overflow, honeypot input positioned at x=-9249 i.e. off-screen).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/admin/stats includes last_alert with webhook_url — OK, _id popped. Good.

Honeypot response returns a fake Appointment with id='honeypot' and status='ignored'. This is fine but note VALID_STATUSES doesn't include 'ignored'; response never touches DB. Not a bug — just document that clients should not treat this as a real appointment (already implicit via id sentinel).

Rate limit uses booking_attempts collection with x-forwarded-for; behind ingress this works, but every request (including 429s) still creates NO attempt row after the limit is hit — so limit is precisely N=5 successes/attempts per hour. If desired, log every attempt including rejected ones for observability.
Login lockout is keyed on ip:email lowercased, count persisted with 1h TTL, 15-min lockout after 5 fails — matches spec.
seed_admin is idempotent: creates if missing, rehashes if password changed. Good.

CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — FastAPI/Starlette will still send credentials, but the browser will refuse to send cookies to '*' origins. Currently frontend and backend are same-origin so this works via cookies naturally. If deployed cross-origin this must be tightened to an explicit origin list. Minor future risk.
Bcrypt hash in DB confirmed to start with $2b$ (verified via login success + verify_password path).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 UI-flow test appointment + 6 rate-limit test appointments. All cleaned up. Also cleared login_attempts and booking_attempts collections. Only demo appointment 'Grace Reyes' remains (appointments count = 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files exist: test_meridian_api.py (appointments/availability) and test_meridian_admin.py (auth/admin/spam-shield). Run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v. Both files auto-clean their test data. NOTE: test_meridian_api.py from iteration 2 hits GET /api/appointments which no longer exists as a public route — that test was passing before because there used to be a public listing endpoint, but current server.py only exposes it under /api/admin/appointments (auth required). If re-running the full old suite it will now fail on that assertion; consider updating it. Booking rate limit test consumes 5/hour for the container IP; if another test runs POST /api/appointments right after, it'll hit the limit — that's why the module-scope fixture in test_meridian_admin.py resets booking_attempts.
